questions: Private aviation: for a private pilot logging 82 hours a year, 351 total hours, no aerobatics, does the desk charge the 50-debit hazardous-avocation rate, a flat extra (and which band), an aviation exclusion rider, or nothing?

Build: the applicant is down 16 lb in the last 12 months (now 200 lb, BMI 33.3) with no reason for the loss documented. Does the desk rate build on the current BMI, on the pre-loss weight, or on a midpoint?

Diabetes: type 2 diagnosed in 2024 at about age 54, diet controlled, A1c 6.6. Does the desk treat this as well-controlled late-onset metabolic disease under section 6, and if so is the 50-debit A1c charge reduced, waived, or left as tabled?

Section 16 combination: BMI 33.3, type 2 diabetes with A1c 6.6, tobacco quit within 5 years and total cholesterol 221 appear together, with BP 119/71 and ratio 4.0. Does the desk add a charge for the combination of cardiac risk factors on top of the individual table debits, and if so how much?
